class.name: OcgGpGtrsf2d
class.brief_description: Defines a non persistent transformation in 2D space. This transformation is a general transformation. It can be a gp_Trsf2d, an affinity, or you can define your own transformation giving the corresponding matrix of transformation.
class.description: ! Defines a non persistent transformation in 2D space. ! This transformation is a general transformation. ! It can be a gp_Trsf2d, an affinity, or you can ! define your own transformation giving the corresponding matrix of transformation. ! ! With a gp_GTrsf2d you can transform only a doublet of coordinates gp_XY. ! It is not possible to transform other geometric objects ! because these transformations can change the nature of non-elementary geometric objects. ! A gp_GTrsf2d is represented with a 2 rows * 3 columns matrix: ! @code ! V1 V2 T XY XY ! | a11 a12 a14 | | x | | x'| ! | a21 a22 a24 | | y | = | y'| ! | 0 0 1 | | 1 | | 1 | ! @endcode ! where {V1, V2} defines the vectorial part of the ! transformation and T defines the translation part of the transformation. ! Warning ! A gp_GTrsf2d transformation is only applicable on coordinates. ! Be careful if you apply such a transformation to all the points of a geometric object, ! as this can change the nature of the object and thus render it incoherent! ! Typically, a circle is transformed into an ellipse by an affinity transformation. ! To avoid modifying the nature of an object, use a gp_Trsf2d transformation instead, ! as objects of this class respect the nature of geometric objects.

method.name: from_gp_Trsf2d_const_ref
method.description: Converts the gp_Trsf2d transformation theT into a general transformation.

method.name: from_gp_Mat2d_const_ref_gp_XY_const_ref
method.description: Creates a transformation based on the matrix theM and the vector theV where theM defines the vectorial part of the transformation, and theV the translation part.

method.name: SetAffinity
method.description: Changes this transformation into an affinity of ratio theRatio with respect to the axis theA. Note: An affinity is a point-by-point transformation that transforms any point P into a point P' such that if H is the orthogonal projection of P on the axis theA, the vectors HP and HP' satisfy: HP' = theRatio * HP.

method.name: SetTranslationPart
method.description: Replaces the translation part of this transformation by the coordinates of the number pair theCoord.

method.name: SetTrsf2d
method.description: Assigns the vectorial and translation parts of theT to this transformation.

method.name: SetVectorialPart
method.description: Replaces the vectorial part of this transformation by theMatrix.

method.name: Form
method.description: Returns the nature of the transformation. It can be an identity transformation, a rotation, a translation, a mirror transformation (relative to a point or axis), a scaling transformation, a compound transformation or some other type of transformation.

method.name: TranslationPart
method.description: Returns the translation part of the GTrsf2d.

method.name: VectorialPart
method.description: Computes the vectorial part of the GTrsf2d. The returned Matrix is a 2*2 matrix.

method.name: Inverted
method.description: Computes the reverse transformation. Raised an exception if the matrix of the transformation is not inversible.

method.name: Multiplied
method.description: Computes the transformation composed with theT and <me>. In a C++ implementation you can also write Tcomposed = <me> * theT. Example :

method.name: PreMultiply
method.description: Computes the product of the transformation theT and this transformation, and assigns the result to this transformation: this = theT * this

method.name: Trsf2d
method.description: Converts this transformation into a gp_Trsf2d transformation. Exceptions Standard_ConstructionError if this transformation cannot be converted, i.e. if its form is gp_Other.
